newsitem.title: UK: Kiln Cotesworth buys Stewart Members Agency.
newsitem.headline: Kiln Cotesworth buys Stewart Members Agency.

text.p: Kiln Cotesworth Members Agency Ltd, a Lloyd's of London insureance market members agent, said on Monday that it had acquired the business of Stewart Members Agency from its parent Stewart Underwriting Plc.
Kiln said that with 800 active Names, or investors in Lloyd's, it would be the third largest members agent in Lloyd's with an estimated total premium capacity of 450 million stg.
The combined group will be called Kiln Cotesworth Stewart Ltd with Adrian Graves, the previous managing director of Stewart Members Agency, to take over as chief executive of the new group.
None of the agencies mentioned any details including consideration regarding the merger.
